cupti_bound.note: The parent attribution locates CUPTI cost almost entirely in the wall residual, but this bucket holds ~3.06 M tiny kernel instances, where per-launch profiler cost concentrates. Band, not point.

elementwise_math.note: chained elementwise ops, each a separate DRAM round trip of a tensor the next op immediately re-reads; the classic fusion target

sampling_and_verification.note: sampler math. The work is required; the SHAPE is not -- torch's generic cumsum/softmax path runs beside vLLM's already-fused _topk_topp_kernel

copies_fills_cats.note: pure tensor plumbing: dtype/layout copies, buffer zero-fills, concatenations. No mandatory tensor exists that only these kernels can produce

gather_scatter_index.note: tree/committer bookkeeping: node gathers, accepted-path scatters, index selects. Real addressing work, but re-materialised per op instead of fused

mandatory_fused_pipeline.note: activation + fp8 quantisation + conv that any implementation of this model must run; already fused, already near its own traffic floor

fr13_state_plumbing.note: fixed32-specific conv staging (pregather / direct col0). 1 launch/step each; already the consolidated form of what used to be 48

reductions_norms.note: reductions and norms outside the fused triton path

unclassified.note: not matched by any rule; treated as mostly-mandatory to stay conservative
